suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update katla_app/AGENTS.md frame order section to mark editor-only steps (poll_background_loader, generate_ui_draw_list, process_editor_actions, render_gizmos) as conditional on the 'editor' feature flag, and add the lifecycle hook insertion points (on_update between world.update and particle_system.update, on_init after build in run(), on_shutdown in cleanup_on_exit).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviews for app-lifecycle-hooks and app-editor-decoupling both flagged that the frame order doc doesn't reflect lifecycle hooks or editor cfg gating.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update .factory/library/architecture.md to document: (1) the 'editor' Cargo feature flag in katla_app (default on, gates editor UI/fields/frame logic), (2) the Spawner extension trait pattern on World for entity creation, (3) the public resource loading API on Application (load_texture, load_mesh, load_animation), (4) the components::lighting module re-export chain via rendering/mod.rs.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviews for app-spawning-decoupling, app-editor-decoupling, app-resource-loading-api, and app-component-visibility all noted missing documentation in architecture.md for new patterns.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update the app-worker skill to acknowledge that TDD is not universally applicable — GPU-dependent features (resource loading, rendering) cannot be unit-tested without a Vulkan renderer. Add guidance on when to skip TDD and what verification to use instead (compile checks, integration tests, manual review).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviews for app-lifecycle-hooks and app-resource-loading-api both noted the TDD mandate in the skill doesn't match actual practice for GPU-dependent or straightforward features.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update the app-worker skill to mention Cargo feature flags and cfg gating patterns. The 'editor' feature flag in katla_app is a new pattern not reflected in the skill. Future workers working on editor or optional features should know about this.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review for app-editor-decoupling noted the app-worker skill has no mention of feature flags or cfg attributes.
